title: Pecan Chicken Thighs with Lemon-Oregano Gravy
description: Skinless chicken thighs take the place of a whole spatchcock bird and stay nestled in a silky lemon and oregano gravy.
equipment: Small enamel Dutch oven with tight lid, sized to hold the food snugly

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.note: Trim surface fat and unfold to an even thickness.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made from meat, bones and water, with no added vegetable blend or seasonings.

ingredients.name: hot drinking water
ingredients.note: Keep ready; use only as needed to maintain liquid depth or make up the sauce measure.

steps.title: Heat the Traeger
steps.text: Preheat the Traeger Silverton 610 to 300°F with pecan pellets, about 15 minutes with the lid closed.

steps.title: Warm the braising liquid
steps.text: Bring {broth} with {oregano} and {garlic} just to a simmer in the open Dutch oven on the stove, about 3–6 minutes.

steps.title: Smoke the braising liquid
steps.text: Move the uncovered pot to the Traeger grate. Close the smoker lid and smoke the liquid for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Nestle the thighs
steps.text: Lay {chicken} flat in the smoked broth, topping up with {topup} if needed to reach halfway up the sides. Fit the lid immediately. No stall wrap is needed.

steps.title: Braise gently
steps.text: Cook covered at 300°F for 25–45 minutes until the thickest centers reach 175°F and a fork slips through easily.

steps.title: Rest in the juices
steps.text: Rest the covered thighs off heat for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Portion the meat
steps.text: Cut the thighs across the grain into small slices and keep covered with a little broth.

steps.title: Measure the sauce base
steps.text: Skim excess fat from the braising liquid. Measure 3/4 cup into the HexClad skillet, topping up with {topup} if needed.

steps.title: Infuse the lemon
steps.text: Stir {zest} into the skillet over medium heat for 1 minute.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the skillet liquid to a boil. Whisk in the stirred slurry and simmer for 1 minute, stirring, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Finish off heat
steps.text: Swirl {butter} and {lemon} into the thick gravy off heat.

steps.title: Coat the thighs
steps.text: Turn the slices in the gravy and spoon the rest around them on both plates.

notes: Make ahead: Trim and unfold the thighs the night before. Option A uses lemon zest and juice. For gentler Option B, omit both and finish with finely chopped parsley. For dairy-free gravy, omit the butter. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze individual portions surrounded by sauce for up to 2 months to protect their moisture. Fridge reheat: Place one portion with its sauce in a covered shallow dish. Install the bottom drip pan in the APO and preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, rear heat on, top and bottom off, 60% steam. Set the probe to 165°F in the center. Start checking after 12 minutes and heat until 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator. Follow the fridge reheating directions and stir the sauce smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 208 kcal, 29.1 g protein, 3.7 g total carbohydrate, 7.8 g fat, 0.2 g fiber, 156 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
